title: The Gold Rush in AI4Math, II: What are signatures of AI-assisted Proofs?
abstract: arXiv:2611.08412v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The growing use of AI in mathematics raises a question: can we detect AI involvement in proofs, separately from AI assistance with writing? Historical arXiv papers, recent papers disclosing substantive AI use, and manuscripts released by OpenAI provide a rich empirical basis for studying this question. However, several challenges remain: lack of matched case-control pairs; potential incompleteness of disclosure; and lack of ready-to-use features designed to capture signals of AI involvement in proofs. These cohorts span different levels of AI involvement and include matched pairs of papers addressing the same research problems. translated_title: AI4Math 的淘金热（二）：AI 辅助证明的特征信号是什么？
translated_abstract: AI 在数学中的应用日益增多，这引发了一个问题：我们能否将 AI 对证明的参与与 AI 对写作的辅助区分开来，检测出前者？历史上的 arXiv 论文、近期披露实质性 AI 使用的论文，以及 OpenAI 发布的手稿，为研究这一问题提供了丰富的实证基础。然而，仍存在若干挑战：缺乏匹配的病例-对照对；披露信息可能不完整；以及缺乏能够捕捉 AI 参与证明信号的即用型特征。为应对这些挑战，我们通过将现有手稿与我们使用生成式 AI 制作的手稿相结合，构建了包含 8,281 篇论文的五个队列。这些队列涵盖了不同程度的 AI 参与水平，并包括针对相同研究问题的匹配论文对。随后，我们提出了 ProofTrace，这是一个将每篇论文表示为即时证明支持图（GIPS）并从中提取可解释特征的框架……
tldr: 本文通过构建包含 8,281 篇论文、涵盖不同 AI 参与程度的五个队列，并提出基于即时证明支持图（GIPS）的 ProofTrace 框架来提取可解释特征，从而实现对数学论文中 AI 参与证明的检测。
en_tdlr: This paper constructs five cohorts of 8,281 papers spanning varying levels of AI involvement and introduces ProofTrace, a framework that represents papers as graphs of immediate proof support (GIPS) to extract interpretable features for detecting AI involvement in mathematical proofs.
